$comment: myAI kernel settings — dropped by `myai init` (greenfield) into a kernel-only repo's .claude/settings.json. Wires the PreToolUse SAFETY hooks (block-push-main, secret-scan, no-local-npm, protected-files) from the installed ai-management module, resolved at hook-exec time WITHOUT depending on PATH: $MYAI_ROOT, then `myai root` (with ~/.local/bin prepended), then the standard global prefixes. A PATH-only lookup made these hooks fail CLOSED intermittently — `myai` lives in ~/.local/bin, which a hook shell does not reliably inherit, so `myai root` returned empty and every Bash call was blocked until an identical retry happened to work (reported from api_management 2026-08-31). The unresolvable diagnostic goes to STDOUT, not stderr: a stderr-only message surfaced as "No stderr output" and hid the cause entirely. The hook BODIES live in the module, never a per-repo copy (plan S-INIT-5, ADR-016 §0.5). Each command FAILS LOUD (exit 2 = block the tool) if the module is unresolvable, so a broken/missing install can never silently run this repo WITHOUT its safety rails. permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions matches the operator's standing config on every other repo — without it a fresh greenfield scaffold falls back to the user-level default (auto) and can't boot into bypass like the rest of the fleet (diagnosed 2026-08-02, exo).

hooks.command: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; _R="${MYAI_ROOT:-}"; [ -z "$_R" ] && _R="$(myai root 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$_R" ] && { for _c in "$HOME/.local/lib/node_modules/ai-management" /usr/local/lib/node_modules/ai-management /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/ai-management; do [ -d "$_c" ] && { _R="$_c"; break; }; done; }; if [ -z "$_R" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: myAI module unresolvable - safety hook (block-push-main) cannot run. Reinstall: npm i -g ai-management  (checked \$MYAI_ROOT, myai root, and the standard global prefixes)"; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$_R/hooks/pre-tool/01-block-push-main.sh"
